Structured schedule

Session 1
- Slot 1: A — new practice (basics)
- Slot 2: Unused

Session 2
- Slot 1: A — retrieval review, exactly 1 session after new practice
- Slot 2: B — new practice (application)
- Cumulative mixing: Yes. Earlier-skill work on A occurs in the same session as newer work on B.

Session 3
- Slot 1: B — retrieval review, exactly 1 session after new practice
- Slot 2: Unused

Constraint audit
- Capacity: 3 sessions × 2 slots = 6 slots.
- Used slots: 4. Unused slots: 2 (Session 1 Slot 2; Session 3 Slot 2).
- Fixed A placement: satisfied; A is introduced in Session 1.
- B prerequisite: satisfied; B is introduced in Session 2 after A was practiced in Session 1.
- Fixed B placement: satisfied; B is introduced in Session 2.
- A retrieval timing: satisfied; reviewed in Session 2, exactly 1 session later.
- B retrieval timing: satisfied; reviewed in Session 3, exactly 1 session later.
- Each new item receives exactly one required retrieval review: satisfied.
- Cumulative mixing identified: Session 2.
- No claim is made about an optimal learning effect.

method_note: Every case uses its own fresh context. Both arms use identical model/effort/budget; raw responses unchanged, original prompts/assertions preserved, prior failures retained. Aggregate is a provenance index, not a model call.
